final: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS test_count FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), totals AS (SELECT AVG(test_count) AS average_count, SUM(test_count) AS total_count FROM sex_counts) SELECT sex, test_count, 1.0 * test_count / total_count AS fraction_of_total, test_count - average_count AS above_average FROM sex_counts CROSS JOIN totals WHERE test_count > average_count
